resources.string: A one-minute tour of the app. The accounts, spending and bills you see now are demo data, so you can try everything out. You can clear them at the end.
Your total balance (tap the eye to show it), low-balance and review alerts, this month\'s spending against your budget, and the next bill due.
Every transaction, grouped by day. Bank SMS are added here automatically. New ones show a badge so you can check the title and category.
Set a budget for each category and a savings goal, and add recurring bills. A bill is marked paid when its payment SMS arrives.
Keep a record of FDs, RDs, stocks, mutual funds, gold, silver, land and more, with the calculations shown step by step.
Allow SMS reading and pick the date to import from, add your bank accounts and cards, and save a full backup.
Clear the demo accounts, transactions and bills now, or keep them to explore a little longer. Categories and budgets stay either way.
You\'re all set. Head to Settings to allow SMS reading and add your accounts.
